description: This file provides utility functions for accessing component and category data stored in local JSON files within a web application's frontend. It includes functions to retrieve all components, fetch a component by ID, filter components by category, list categories, and get featured components. It also invokes a validation function to ensure component IDs are unique during development.

methods.name: getAllComponents()
methods.description: Returns an array of all component objects available in the local registry.

methods.name: getComponentById(id)
methods.description: Finds and returns a component object by its unique id; returns undefined if not found.

methods.name: getComponentsByCategory(categorySlug)
methods.description: Filters and returns components that belong to a specified category slug.

methods.name: getCategories()
methods.description: Returns an array of category objects each containing name, slug, and description.

methods.name: getFeaturedComponents(limit = 6)
methods.description: Returns a subset of featured components, limited by a specified number; defaults to 6.
